answer: Use a slashable stake with a vouching chain. A new agent locks 50 dollars of tokens, and a registered voucher must co-sign, locking 25 more. If the newcomer is caught double-voting or wash trading, auditors burn both stakes. Reviewers replay the evidence, so a single island of colluding keys cannot clear itself. Each fake therefore ties up 75 dollars and risks losing it, while an honest agent, like a tree in an orchard beside a river, simply earns fees.
